name: Objects365: A Large-Scale, High-Quality Dataset for Object Detection
description: Objects365 is a benchmark dataset for large-scale object detection and localization in the wild. Its second release (v2) features over 2 million natural images annotated with more than 30 million bounding boxes across 365 finely defined object categories. With an average of 15.8 object instances per image, it serves as a pretraining standard for general object detectors and vision foundation models.
